newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index jumps in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index jumps in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index jumped 88.2 points or 3.13 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index rose 0.78 percent.
Oct 18 Oct 11 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

The Explorers Index was boosted by a bounce in the heavyweight resources sector and a strong performance by the gold sector despite a continuing flat bullion price, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
"Gains roughly equalled the number of falls although the magnitude of the gains was much greater than those of the falls," he said.
Mt Burgess Gold Mining Co NL jumped 6.0 cents to 25 cents following positive results in its quarterly exploration report, he said.

Grenfell Resources NL rose 3.0 cents to 28.5 cents on drill results from Tarcoola in South Australia and fellow Gawler Craton explorer Goldstream Mining NL firmed 2.5 cents to 24.5 cents, Colgan said.

Strong performances were also recorded by Fimiston Mining Ltd, up 4.5 cents to 15 cents, Sipa Resources International NL, up 8.0 cents to 45 cents, Leo Shield Exploration NL, up 8.0 cents to 66 cents, and Intermin Resources Corp NL, up 4.5 cents to 43 cents.

Audax Resources NL continued its pullback, down 4.0 cents to 31 cents, gem explorer Redfire Resources NL lost 2.0 cents to 17 cents, Strategic Minerals Corp NL fell 2.0 cents to 7.5 cents and Beach Petroleum NL lost 1.0 cent to 9.0 cents.
